# Cubby UI

> Framework-agnostic UI component library. Pure HTML + Tailwind CSS. No React, Vue, or any JS framework required. Components are designed to copy-paste directly into any project.

## Installation

```html
<!-- Option A: CDN -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/cubby-ui/dist/core/cubby-ui.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/cubby-ui/dist/core/cubby-ui.min.js"></script>

<!-- Option B: npm -->
<!-- npm install cubby-ui -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/cubby-ui/dist/core/cubby-ui.css">
<script src="node_modules/cubby-ui/dist/core/cubby-ui.js"></script>
```

```js
// ES module
import 'cubby-ui/css';
import CubbyUI from 'cubby-ui';
```

## CSS Class Naming Convention

All classes use the `cu-` prefix.

- Base: `cu-{component}` — e.g. `cu-button`, `cu-input`, `cu-card`
- Variant: `cu-{component}-{variant}` — e.g. `cu-button-destructive`, `cu-badge-success`
- Size: `cu-{component}-{size}` — e.g. `cu-button-sm`, `cu-button-lg`
- Sub-element: `cu-{component}-{part}` — e.g. `cu-card-header`, `cu-sidebar-item`
- Wrapper: `cu-{component}-wrapper` — e.g. `cu-checkbox-wrapper`, `cu-select-wrapper`
- State: `cu-{component}-{part}-{state}` — e.g. `cu-sidebar-item-active`, `cu-tabs-trigger-active`
- Modifier: `cu-{component}-{modifier}` — e.g. `cu-card-hover` (opt-in shadow)

## JavaScript API

Interactive components are initialized automatically on `DOMContentLoaded`.

```js
CubbyUI.init()     // Initialize all interactive components. Safe to call repeatedly.
CubbyUI.destroy()  // Clear internal tracking arrays (use before SPA route transition).
CubbyUI.refresh()  // Remove stale refs + re-init (use after dynamic content updates).
```

Interactive components use `data-*` attributes — no JS calls required for markup-driven usage.

## Design System

Semantic color tokens (CSS variables, use in Tailwind or plain CSS):
- `--color-primary` / `--color-primary-foreground`
- `--color-secondary` / `--color-secondary-foreground`
- `--color-destructive` / `--color-destructive-foreground`
- `--color-success` / `--color-success-foreground`
- `--color-warning` / `--color-warning-foreground`
- `--color-info` / `--color-info-foreground`
- `--color-muted` / `--color-muted-foreground`
- `--color-accent` / `--color-accent-foreground`
- `--color-background` / `--color-foreground`
- `--color-card` / `--color-card-foreground`
- `--color-border`, `--color-input`, `--color-ring`
- `--color-chart-1` … `--color-chart-5` — categorical chart palette (fixed order; validated for color-vision deficiency and 3:1 contrast in both modes)

Dark mode: add `.dark` class on `<html>` or `<body>`.

---

## Components Reference

### Typography

**Headings** (H1 to H5)
```html
<h1 class="cu-h1">Heading 1</h1>
<h2 class="cu-h2">Heading 2</h2>
<h3 class="cu-h3">Heading 3</h3>
<h4 class="cu-h4">Heading 4</h4>
<h5 class="cu-h5">Heading 5</h5>
```

**Paragraph**
```html
<p class="cu-paragraph">Body text</p>
<p class="cu-paragraph cu-paragraph-lead">Lead paragraph (larger)</p>
```

**Kbd** — keyboard shortcut badge
Classes: `cu-kbd`, `cu-kbd-sm`, `cu-kbd-lg`
```html
<kbd class="cu-kbd">Ctrl</kbd>
```

**Blockquote**
```html
<blockquote class="cu-blockquote">Quote text</blockquote>
```

**List**
```html
<ul class="cu-list cu-list-disc"><li>Item</li></ul>
<ol class="cu-list cu-list-decimal"><li>Item</li></ol>
```

**Link**
```html
<a href="#" class="cu-link">Link text</a>
```

**Text** — inline text utilities
```html
<span class="cu-text-large">Large emphasized text</span>
<span class="cu-text-small">Small medium label</span>
<span class="cu-text-muted">Muted secondary text</span>
```

**HR**
```html
<hr class="cu-hr">
```

---

### Basic

**Aspect Ratio** — constrains child content to a specific aspect ratio
Classes: `cu-aspect-ratio` (container, relative + overflow-hidden), `cu-aspect-ratio-16/9`, `cu-aspect-ratio-4/3`, `cu-aspect-ratio-1/1`, `cu-aspect-ratio-21/9`, `cu-aspect-ratio-3/2`, `cu-aspect-ratio-2/3`, `cu-aspect-ratio-9/16`, `cu-aspect-ratio-3/4`, `cu-aspect-ratio-5/4`
Child elements are stretched to fill via absolute positioning + `object-cover`.
```html
<div class="cu-aspect-ratio cu-aspect-ratio-16/9">
  <img src="photo.jpg" alt="Landscape">
</div>
```

**Button**
Base: `cu-button`
Variants: `cu-button-default` (solid primary), `cu-button-destructive`, `cu-button-outline`, `cu-button-ghost`, `cu-button-link`
Sizes: `cu-button-sm`, `cu-button-lg`
Icon buttons: `cu-button-icon` (h-9 w-9), `cu-button-icon-sm` (h-8 w-8), `cu-button-icon-xs` (h-7 w-7)
Block: `cu-button-block` (always full-width), `cu-button-block-sm` (full-width on mobile, auto on sm+)
```html
<button class="cu-button cu-button-default">Button</button>
<button class="cu-button cu-button-outline cu-button-sm">Small Outline</button>
<button class="cu-button cu-button-ghost cu-button-icon" aria-label="Settings"><!-- icon svg --></button>
```

**Button Group**
```html
<div class="cu-button-group">
  <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline">Left</button>
  <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline">Middle</button>
  <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline">Right</button>
</div>
<!-- Vertical: add cu-button-group-vertical -->
```

**Card**
Sub-elements: `cu-card-header`, `cu-card-title`, `cu-card-description`, `cu-card-content`, `cu-card-footer`
Modifiers: `cu-card-hover` (opt-in hover shadow), `cu-card-elevated` (shadow-md), `cu-card-content-flush` (p-0 content)
Image: `cu-card-img-top` (top image with flush border radius)
Horizontal: `cu-card-horizontal` (flex-row layout), `cu-card-horizontal-img` (side image, w-48)
Selectable: `cu-card-selectable` (ring on checked state via `:has(input:checked)`)
```html
<div class="cu-card">
  <div class="cu-card-header">
    <h3 class="cu-card-title">Title</h3>
    <p class="cu-card-description">Description</p>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-card-content">Content</div>
  <div class="cu-card-footer">Footer</div>
</div>
```

**Copy Button** ⚡ JS-driven (document-level delegated click; dynamically added buttons work without re-init)
Classes: `cu-copy-button` (ghost, h-8, square when icon-only), `cu-copy-button-outline`, `cu-copy-button-sm` (h-7), `cu-copy-button-lg` (h-9), `cu-copy-button-icon` (copy icon, hidden while copied), `cu-copy-button-check` (check icon, shown while copied)
Copy Field: `cu-copy-field` (read-only value + button), `cu-copy-field-value` (code / span / input readonly, truncated mono text), `cu-copy-field-muted` (tinted, no shadow), `cu-copy-field-multiline` (keeps line breaks, scrolls)
Data: `data-cu-copy="text"` or `data-cu-copy-target="#selector"` (input/textarea/select → value, other elements → trimmed textContent); optional `data-cu-copy-label` (child text swaps to the message), `data-cu-copy-success-text` (default "Copied!"), `data-cu-copy-error-text` (default "Copy failed"), `data-cu-copy-duration` (ms, default 2000), `data-cu-copy-live` (custom aria-live region; auto-created otherwise)
States: `data-cu-copied` (success), `data-cu-copy-failed` (Clipboard API unavailable / denied and execCommand fallback failed). Events: `cu:copy-button:copy` (detail.text), `cu:copy-button:error` (detail.error), both bubble.
A11y: icon-only buttons need `aria-label`; messages are announced via a shared visually hidden `role="status"` `aria-live="polite"` region.
```html
<button type="button" class="cu-copy-button" data-cu-copy="usr_8f2a91c4" aria-label="Copy user ID">
  <svg class="cu-copy-button-icon" aria-hidden="true"><!-- copy icon --></svg>
  <svg class="cu-copy-button-check" aria-hidden="true"><!-- check icon --></svg>
</button>

<div class="cu-copy-field">
  <code id="api-key" class="cu-copy-field-value">sk_live_51H8xQ2</code>
  <button type="button" class="cu-copy-button cu-copy-button-sm" data-cu-copy-target="#api-key" aria-label="Copy API key">
    <svg class="cu-copy-button-icon" aria-hidden="true"><!-- copy icon --></svg>
    <svg class="cu-copy-button-check" aria-hidden="true"><!-- check icon --></svg>
  </button>
</div>

<button type="button" class="cu-copy-button cu-copy-button-outline" data-cu-copy="https://example.com/invite">
  <svg class="cu-copy-button-icon" aria-hidden="true"><!-- copy icon --></svg>
  <svg class="cu-copy-button-check" aria-hidden="true"><!-- check icon --></svg>
  <span data-cu-copy-label>Copy link</span>
</button>
```

**Separator**
Requires explicit direction class.
```html
<hr class="cu-separator cu-separator-horizontal"> <!-- horizontal line -->
<div class="cu-separator cu-separator-vertical"></div> <!-- vertical line -->
```

**Avatar**
Sizes: `cu-avatar-sm`, `cu-avatar-lg`, `cu-avatar-xl`
Status: `cu-avatar-status` + `cu-avatar-status-online` / `cu-avatar-status-offline` / `cu-avatar-status-busy` / `cu-avatar-status-away`
Shape: `cu-avatar-square` (rounded-lg instead of rounded-full)
Ring: `cu-avatar-ring`
```html
<div class="cu-avatar">
  <img class="cu-avatar-image" src="photo.jpg" alt="User">
  <span class="cu-avatar-fallback">AB</span>
</div>
```

**Badge**
Variants: `cu-badge-default`, `cu-badge-secondary`, `cu-badge-destructive`, `cu-badge-outline`, `cu-badge-success`, `cu-badge-warning`, `cu-badge-info`
Sizes: `cu-badge-sm`, `cu-badge-lg`
Dot animation: `cu-badge-dot-animated` (pulsing animation on dot indicator)
```html
<span class="cu-badge cu-badge-default">New</span>
<span class="cu-badge cu-badge-success cu-badge-sm">Active</span>
```

---

### Forms

**Input**
Sizes: `cu-input-sm`, `cu-input-lg`
Validation: `cu-input-error`, `cu-input-success`
Clearable: `cu-input-clearable` (extra right padding for clear button), `cu-input-clear` (clear button)
Data attributes: `data-cu-input-clearable` (on container), `data-cu-input-clear` (on clear button; shown only while the input has a value)
```html
<input type="text" class="cu-input" placeholder="Placeholder">
<input type="text" class="cu-input cu-input-error" placeholder="Error state">

<!-- Clearable -->
<div class="cu-input-icon-wrapper" data-cu-input-clearable>
  <input type="text" class="cu-input cu-input-clearable" placeholder="Type to search..." aria-label="Search">
  <button type="button" class="cu-input-clear" data-cu-input-clear aria-label="Clear"><svg aria-hidden="true"><!-- x icon --></svg></button>
</div>
```

**Input Group** — combine input with text/icon addons
Classes: `cu-input-group` (flex container, merges border-radius), `cu-input-group-text` (text/icon addon with muted bg), `cu-input-group-disabled` (disabled state for entire group)
Children border-radius is auto-reset; first child gets `rounded-l-lg`, last gets `rounded-r-lg`. Adjacent children overlap borders with `-ml-px`.
```html
<div class="cu-input-group">
  <span class="cu-input-group-text">https://</span>
  <input type="text" class="cu-input" placeholder="example.com">
</div>
```

**Password Input** ⚡ Interactive — input with toggle visibility button
Classes: `cu-password-input` (container), `cu-password-input-field` (the text input, `pr-9` for toggle space), `cu-password-input-toggle` (eye icon button)
Data attributes: `data-cu-password-input`, `data-cu-password-toggle`, `data-cu-password-icon-show`, `data-cu-password-icon-hide`
```html
<div class="cu-password-input" data-cu-password-input>
  <input class="cu-password-input-field" type="password" placeholder="Enter password">
  <button type="button" class="cu-password-input-toggle" data-cu-password-toggle aria-label="Toggle password visibility">
    <svg data-cu-password-icon-show><!-- eye icon --></svg>
    <svg data-cu-password-icon-hide style="display:none"><!-- eye-off icon --></svg>
  </button>
</div>
```

**Pin Input** ⚡ Interactive — multi-digit verification code input
Classes: `cu-pin-input` (container), `cu-pin-input-field` (individual digit box)
Sizes: `cu-pin-input-sm`, `cu-pin-input-lg`
Error: `cu-pin-input-error` (destructive border)
Data attributes: `data-cu-pin-input`, `data-cu-pin-input-type="numeric|alphanumeric"`
```html
<div class="cu-pin-input" data-cu-pin-input data-cu-pin-input-type="numeric">
  <input class="cu-pin-input-field" type="text" maxlength="1" inputmode="numeric">
  <input class="cu-pin-input-field" type="text" maxlength="1" inputmode="numeric">
  <input class="cu-pin-input-field" type="text" maxlength="1" inputmode="numeric">
  <input class="cu-pin-input-field" type="text" maxlength="1" inputmode="numeric">
</div>
```

**Textarea**
Validation: `cu-textarea-error`, `cu-textarea-success`
Auto-resize: `cu-textarea-auto` (uses `field-sizing: content`)
```html
<textarea class="cu-textarea"></textarea>
<textarea class="cu-textarea cu-textarea-auto"></textarea>
```

**Label**
Required marker: `cu-label-required` (adds red asterisk after label)
Always associate the label with its control (`for` = the control's `id`, or wrap the control) so clicking the label focuses the field.
```html
<label for="field-name" class="cu-label">Field Name</label>
<input id="field-name" class="cu-input">
<label for="required-field" class="cu-label cu-label-required">Required Field</label>
<input id="required-field" class="cu-input" required>
```

**Select** — custom arrow decoration
- `cu-select-sm` — small size (h-8, matches cu-button-sm)
```html
<div class="cu-select-wrapper">
  <select class="cu-select">
    <option>Option 1</option>
  </select>
</div>
```

**Checkbox** — custom SVG checkmark
The checkmark is drawn with a mask in `--color-primary-foreground`, so it follows the theme (a light brand `--color-primary` paired with a dark foreground gets a dark check). Setting `input.indeterminate = true` shows a dash.
```html
<div class="cu-checkbox-wrapper">
  <input type="checkbox" id="cb1" class="cu-checkbox">
  <label for="cb1">Check me</label>
</div>
```

**Checkbox Group** ⚡ Interactive — group of checkboxes with optional select-all
Classes: `cu-checkbox-group` (container), `cu-checkbox-group-label` (group label), `cu-checkbox-group-items` (items container, indented), `cu-checkbox-group-selectall` (select-all wrapper with bottom border)
Data attributes: `data-cu-checkbox-group` (container), `data-cu-checkbox-group-selectall` (select-all checkbox), `data-cu-checkbox-group-item` (each item checkbox). Select-all toggles every enabled item and shows the indeterminate state when only some are checked.
```html
<div class="cu-checkbox-group" data-cu-checkbox-group>
  <span class="cu-checkbox-group-label">Interests</span>
  <div class="cu-checkbox-group-selectall">
    <div class="cu-checkbox-wrapper">
      <input type="checkbox" id="all" class="cu-checkbox" data-cu-checkbox-group-selectall>
      <label for="all">Select All</label>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-checkbox-group-items">
    <div class="cu-checkbox-wrapper">
      <input type="checkbox" id="opt1" class="cu-checkbox" data-cu-checkbox-group-item>
      <label for="opt1">Option 1</label>
    </div>
    <div class="cu-checkbox-wrapper">
      <input type="checkbox" id="opt2" class="cu-checkbox" data-cu-checkbox-group-item>
      <label for="opt2">Option 2</label>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Color Picker** ⚡ Interactive — HSV saturation panel + hue slider + hex input + preset swatches
Classes: `cu-color-picker` (container, popover-styled), `cu-color-picker-saturation` (SV panel, crosshair cursor), `cu-color-picker-saturation-pointer` (draggable dot), `cu-color-picker-hue` (rainbow gradient bar), `cu-color-picker-hue-pointer` (draggable dot), `cu-color-picker-controls` (preview + input row), `cu-color-picker-preview` (color swatch), `cu-color-picker-input` (hex text field), `cu-color-picker-swatches` (grid container), `cu-color-picker-swatch` (individual swatch button)
Data attributes: `data-cu-color-picker`, `data-cu-color-picker-value`, `data-cu-color-picker-saturation`, `data-cu-color-picker-saturation-pointer`, `data-cu-color-picker-hue`, `data-cu-color-picker-hue-pointer`, `data-cu-color-picker-preview`, `data-cu-color-picker-input`, `data-cu-color-picker-hidden`, `data-cu-color-picker-swatch`
Keyboard (set by JS): the saturation panel and hue bar become focusable `role="slider"` (default names "Saturation and brightness" / "Hue"; override with `aria-label`). Saturation panel: ← / → saturation ±1%, ↑ / ↓ brightness ±1% (Shift ×10), Page Up / Page Down brightness ±10%, Home / End saturation 0 / 100%. Hue: ← / ↓ −1°, → / ↑ +1° (Shift ×10), Page Up / Page Down ±10°, Home / End 0° / 360°.
Event: `cu:color-picker:change` (`detail.value` = "#rrggbb", bubbles) on the root whenever the user changes the color — continuously while dragging, keyboard, valid hex input, swatches; not on init.
```html
<div class="cu-color-picker" data-cu-color-picker data-cu-color-picker-value="#ff0000">
  <div class="cu-color-picker-saturation" data-cu-color-picker-saturation>
    <div class="cu-color-picker-saturation-pointer" data-cu-color-picker-saturation-pointer></div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-color-picker-hue" data-cu-color-picker-hue>
    <div class="cu-color-picker-hue-pointer" data-cu-color-picker-hue-pointer></div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-color-picker-controls">
    <div class="cu-color-picker-preview" data-cu-color-picker-preview></div>
    <input type="text" class="cu-color-picker-input" data-cu-color-picker-input value="#ff0000" maxlength="7">
  </div>
  <input type="hidden" data-cu-color-picker-hidden value="#ff0000">
  <div class="cu-color-picker-swatches">
    <button type="button" class="cu-color-picker-swatch" data-cu-color-picker-swatch="#ef4444" style="background-color: #ef4444;" aria-label="Select #ef4444"></button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Radio** — custom dot style
```html
<div class="cu-radio-wrapper">
  <input type="radio" id="r1" name="group" class="cu-radio">
  <label for="r1">Option</label>
</div>
```

**Toggle** — CSS-only, hidden checkbox + sibling
Sizes: `cu-toggle-sm`, `cu-toggle-lg`
```html
<div class="cu-toggle-wrapper">
  <input type="checkbox" id="t1" class="cu-toggle">
  <label for="t1">Toggle label</label>
</div>
```

**Range** (slider)
```html
<input type="range" class="cu-range" min="0" max="100" value="50">
```

**Search Input**
```html
<div class="cu-search-input-wrapper">
  <input type="search" class="cu-search-input" placeholder="Search...">
</div>
```

**File Input**
```html
<div class="cu-file-input-wrapper">
  <input type="file" class="cu-file-input">
</div>
```

**Form Group** — wraps label + input + description/error
```html
<div class="cu-form-group">
  <label for="name" class="cu-label cu-label-required">Name</label>
  <input id="name" class="cu-input" required aria-describedby="name-help name-error">
  <p id="name-help" class="cu-form-description">Helper text</p>
  <p id="name-error" class="cu-form-error">Error message</p>
</div>
```

**Number Input** ⚡ Interactive
`data-cu-number-input` on container, `data-cu-number-field` on `<input>`, `data-cu-number-decrement` / `data-cu-number-increment` on buttons. Give the buttons `type="button"` so they never submit a surrounding `<form>`.
```html
<div class="cu-number-input" data-cu-number-input>
  <button type="button" class="cu-button cu-button-outline cu-button-icon-sm" data-cu-number-decrement aria-label="Decrease">−</button>
  <input type="number" class="cu-input" data-cu-number-field min="0" max="100" step="1" value="0" aria-label="Quantity">
  <button type="button" class="cu-button cu-button-outline cu-button-icon-sm" data-cu-number-increment aria-label="Increase">+</button>
</div>
```

**Combobox** ⚡ Interactive — searchable select
Key data attributes: `data-cu-combobox`, `data-cu-combobox-trigger`, `data-cu-combobox-content`, `data-cu-combobox-input`, `data-cu-combobox-item`, `data-cu-combobox-value`, `data-cu-combobox-empty`, `data-cu-combobox-list`
Active item: add `cu-combobox-item-active` class to pre-selected item.
Trigger: a `<button type="button">` (keyboard focusable; never submits a surrounding `<form>`).
Search debounce (optional): `data-cu-combobox-debounce="300"` on the root delays filtering until typing pauses for N ms (default: filter on every keystroke). Clearing the query, arrow keys and Enter apply pending filtering immediately. Events: `cu:combobox:change` (`{ value, item }`), `cu:combobox:search` (`{ query }`, fired when the applied query changes — use it for remote search).
Remote search: on `cu:combobox:search`, remove the `data-cu-combobox-item` elements (keep `data-cu-combobox-empty` in the list) and append the results; items added after init get `role="option"` and the empty state updates automatically, and keyboard navigation / selection work on them. Drop responses that arrive after a newer query.
A11y (APG combobox, set by JS): the search input gets `role="combobox"`, `aria-controls` (listbox id), `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-expanded="true"` and `aria-activedescendant` → the keyboard-highlighted option (ids auto-generated; cleared when filtered out or closed). Without a search input the trigger becomes `role="combobox"` (select-only combobox) and owns `aria-activedescendant` — name it with `aria-label` or `<label for>` (if it has neither, JS uses the placeholder text as its `aria-label`).
```html
<div class="cu-combobox" data-cu-combobox>
  <button type="button" class="cu-combobox-trigger" data-cu-combobox-trigger>
    <span data-cu-combobox-value class="cu-combobox-trigger-placeholder">Select...</span>
  </button>
  <div class="cu-combobox-content" data-cu-combobox-content hidden>
    <input class="cu-combobox-input" data-cu-combobox-input placeholder="Search...">
    <ul data-cu-combobox-list>
      <li class="cu-combobox-item" data-cu-combobox-item>Option 1</li>
      <li class="cu-combobox-item" data-cu-combobox-item>Option 2</li>
    </ul>
    <div data-cu-combobox-empty hidden>No results</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Date Picker** ⚡ Interactive — calendar popup for date selection
Calendar classes: `cu-calendar` (container, popover-styled), `cu-calendar-header` (month/year nav row), `cu-calendar-title` (current month text), `cu-calendar-nav` (prev/next button), `cu-calendar-weekdays` (weekday header grid), `cu-calendar-weekday` (individual weekday), `cu-calendar-grid` (day grid), `cu-calendar-day` (day cell), `cu-calendar-day-today` (today highlight), `cu-calendar-day-selected` (selected day, primary bg), `cu-calendar-day-outside` (prev/next month days, dimmed), `cu-calendar-day-disabled` (non-selectable)
Picker classes: `cu-date-picker` (wrapper), `cu-date-picker-trigger` (input-like button), `cu-date-picker-trigger-icon` (calendar icon), `cu-date-picker-trigger-placeholder` (placeholder text style), `cu-date-picker-content` (dropdown container)
Picker data attributes: `data-cu-date-picker`, `data-cu-date-picker-trigger`, `data-cu-date-picker-value` (formatted date `YYYY/MM/DD`), `data-cu-date-picker-input` (hidden input, ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`), `data-cu-date-picker-content`
Calendar data attributes (required — JS initializes nothing without them): `data-cu-calendar` (on `.cu-calendar`, also inside a Date Picker), `data-cu-calendar-title`, `data-cu-calendar-grid` (leave empty — day buttons are rendered by JS), `data-cu-calendar-prev` / `data-cu-calendar-next`; optional `data-cu-calendar-min` / `data-cu-calendar-max` (`YYYY-MM-DD`)
Keyboard: arrow keys move by day / week (crossing months), Home / End jump to the first / last day of the month, Enter / Space select, Escape closes the picker and returns focus to the trigger.
Value: after each selection the hidden input gets the ISO date and a bubbling `change` event is dispatched on it; a preset `value` opens the calendar on that month. A standalone calendar is the same `.cu-calendar` markup without the picker wrapper.
A11y (APG Date Picker Dialog + grid, set by JS): trigger `aria-haspopup="dialog"` / `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`; content is a non-modal `role="dialog"` labelled by the month title; opening focuses the selected date (else today, else the first selectable date in range). The day grid is `role="grid"` (labelled by the title) with one `cu-calendar-week` `role="row"` per week and `role="gridcell"` day buttons with a single Tab stop (roving tabindex). Each day is named with the full date via `Intl.DateTimeFormat` — locale from `data-cu-calendar-locale` (on the calendar or any ancestor), else the nearest `lang`, else en-US; the month title uses the same locale (zh-TW: `2026年3月`), while the weekday row is static markup you write in the page language; selected day `aria-selected="true"`, today `aria-current="date"`.
```html
<div class="cu-date-picker" data-cu-date-picker>
  <button type="button" class="cu-date-picker-trigger" data-cu-date-picker-trigger>
    <svg class="cu-date-picker-trigger-icon" aria-hidden="true"><!-- calendar icon --></svg>
    <span data-cu-date-picker-value class="cu-date-picker-trigger-placeholder">Pick a date</span>
  </button>
  <input type="hidden" name="date" data-cu-date-picker-input value="">
  <div class="cu-date-picker-content" data-cu-date-picker-content>
    <div class="cu-calendar" data-cu-calendar>
      <div class="cu-calendar-header">
        <button type="button" class="cu-calendar-nav" data-cu-calendar-prev aria-label="Previous month">‹</button>
        <span class="cu-calendar-title" data-cu-calendar-title></span>
        <button type="button" class="cu-calendar-nav" data-cu-calendar-next aria-label="Next month">›</button>
      </div>
      <div class="cu-calendar-weekdays">
        <span class="cu-calendar-weekday">Su</span>
        <span class="cu-calendar-weekday">Mo</span>
        <span class="cu-calendar-weekday">Tu</span>
        <span class="cu-calendar-weekday">We</span>
        <span class="cu-calendar-weekday">Th</span>
        <span class="cu-calendar-weekday">Fr</span>
        <span class="cu-calendar-weekday">Sa</span>
      </div>
      <div class="cu-calendar-grid" data-cu-calendar-grid></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
  document.querySelector("[data-cu-date-picker-input]").addEventListener("change", function (e) {
    console.log("selected", e.target.value); // "2026-03-15"
  });
</script>
```

**Multi Select** ⚡ Interactive — multiple selection with tags
Key data attributes: `data-cu-multi-select`, `data-cu-multi-select-trigger`, `data-cu-multi-select-content`, `data-cu-multi-select-input`, `data-cu-multi-select-item` (with `data-cu-value`), `data-cu-multi-select-tags`, `data-cu-multi-select-placeholder`, `data-cu-multi-select-list`, `data-cu-multi-select-empty`
Search debounce (optional): `data-cu-multi-select-debounce="300"` on the root delays filtering until typing pauses for N ms (default: filter on every keystroke). Clearing the query, arrow keys and Enter apply pending filtering immediately. Events: `cu:multiselect:change` (`{ selected }`), `cu:multiselect:search` (`{ query }`, fired when the applied query changes — use it for remote search).
Trigger: a `<button type="button">` — a `<div>` trigger cannot be focused or opened with the keyboard. Pre-select items with `cu-multi-select-item-active`; selected tags (with remove buttons) are rendered by JS into `data-cu-multi-select-tags`.
Structure: `cu-multi-select-control` (the box) holds the tags container `data-cu-multi-select-tags` and the trigger `<button>` as SIBLINGS — tags carry their own remove `<button type="button">`, so never put the tags inside the trigger (markup from earlier versions that does is restructured on init). The placeholder lives in the trigger; leave the tags container empty (JS renders tags, it collapses while empty). Clicking empty space in the control opens the panel.
A11y: same combobox ARIA as Combobox (search input, or the trigger when there is none, owns `aria-activedescendant`). Generated tag remove buttons are named "Remove {label}"; localize with `data-cu-multi-select-remove-text="移除 {label}"` on the root (`{label}` = item text). Remove buttons precede the trigger in Tab order; removing one from the keyboard focuses the next tag's remove button, or the trigger after the last. With a search input the trigger stays a button named by its text, so while tags hide the placeholder it keeps that text as its name (`aria-labelledby`), unless it has `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` / `<label for>` (without a search input the trigger is a select-only combobox and, like Combobox, gets the placeholder text as its `aria-label`).
```html
<div class="cu-multi-select" data-cu-multi-select>
  <div class="cu-multi-select-control">
    <div class="cu-multi-select-tags" data-cu-multi-select-tags></div>
    <button type="button" class="cu-multi-select-trigger" data-cu-multi-select-trigger>
      <span class="cu-multi-select-placeholder" data-cu-multi-select-placeholder>Select options...</span>
      <svg class="cu-multi-select-icon" aria-hidden="true"><!-- chevrons icon --></svg>
    </button>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-multi-select-content" data-cu-multi-select-content hidden>
    <div class="cu-multi-select-search">
      <input class="cu-multi-select-input" data-cu-multi-select-input placeholder="Search..." aria-label="Search options">
    </div>
    <div class="cu-multi-select-list" data-cu-multi-select-list>
      <div class="cu-multi-select-empty" data-cu-multi-select-empty hidden>No results</div>
      <div class="cu-multi-select-item" data-cu-multi-select-item data-cu-value="opt1">Option 1</div>
      <div class="cu-multi-select-item" data-cu-multi-select-item data-cu-value="opt2">Option 2</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Dropzone** ⚡ Interactive — drag-and-drop file upload
Classes: `cu-dropzone`, `cu-dropzone-input` (visually hidden but focusable file input — do not use the `hidden` attribute, keyboard users open the picker by focusing it and pressing Space / Enter), `cu-dropzone-icon`, `cu-dropzone-title`, `cu-dropzone-description`, `cu-dropzone-disabled`
```html
<div class="cu-dropzone" data-cu-dropzone>
  <input type="file" class="cu-dropzone-input" data-cu-dropzone-input multiple aria-label="Upload files">
  <p class="cu-dropzone-title">Drop files here or click to upload</p>
</div>
```
Active drag state: `cu-dropzone-active` class is toggled automatically. Dropped files are assigned to the input and a `change` event is dispatched on it.

**Transfer List** ⚡ Interactive — move items between two lists
Classes: `cu-transfer-list`, `cu-transfer-list-panel`, `cu-transfer-list-header`, `cu-transfer-list-header-title`, `cu-transfer-list-header-count`, `cu-transfer-list-search`, `cu-transfer-list-search-input`, `cu-transfer-list-content`, `cu-transfer-list-item`, `cu-transfer-list-actions`, `cu-transfer-list-actions-button`
Each item must be a `.cu-transfer-list-item` inside `.cu-transfer-list-content`, and both panels need a `.cu-transfer-list-content` (moved items are appended there). Action buttons need `type="button"`.
```html
<div class="cu-transfer-list" data-cu-transfer-list>
  <div class="cu-transfer-list-panel" data-cu-transfer-panel="left">
    <div class="cu-transfer-list-header">
      <input type="checkbox" class="cu-checkbox" data-cu-transfer-check-all="left" aria-label="Select all available">
      <span class="cu-transfer-list-header-title">Available</span>
      <span class="cu-transfer-list-header-count" data-cu-transfer-count="left"></span>
    </div>
    <div class="cu-transfer-list-search">
      <input class="cu-transfer-list-search-input" data-cu-transfer-search="left" placeholder="Search..." aria-label="Search available">
    </div>
    <div class="cu-transfer-list-content">
      <label class="cu-transfer-list-item">
        <input type="checkbox" class="cu-checkbox" data-cu-transfer-check data-cu-value="item1">
        <span>Item 1</span>
      </label>
      <label class="cu-transfer-list-item">
        <input type="checkbox" class="cu-checkbox" data-cu-transfer-check data-cu-value="item2">
        <span>Item 2</span>
      </label>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-transfer-list-actions">
    <button type="button" class="cu-transfer-list-actions-button" data-cu-transfer-to-right aria-label="Move to selected" disabled>→</button>
    <button type="button" class="cu-transfer-list-actions-button" data-cu-transfer-to-left aria-label="Move to available" disabled>←</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-transfer-list-panel" data-cu-transfer-panel="right">
    <div class="cu-transfer-list-header">
      <input type="checkbox" class="cu-checkbox" data-cu-transfer-check-all="right" aria-label="Select all selected">
      <span class="cu-transfer-list-header-title">Selected</span>
      <span class="cu-transfer-list-header-count" data-cu-transfer-count="right"></span>
    </div>
    <div class="cu-transfer-list-search">
      <input class="cu-transfer-list-search-input" data-cu-transfer-search="right" placeholder="Search..." aria-label="Search selected">
    </div>
    <div class="cu-transfer-list-content"></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Toggle Group** — switchable button group (single or multiple selection)
Classes: `cu-toggle-group`, `cu-toggle-group-item`, `cu-toggle-group-item-active`, `cu-toggle-group-outline`, `cu-toggle-group-multiple`, `cu-toggle-group-sm`, `cu-toggle-group-lg`, `cu-toggle-group-block`
Data: `data-cu-toggle-group`, `data-cu-toggle-group-multiple`
```html
<div class="cu-toggle-group" data-cu-toggle-group>
  <button type="button" class="cu-toggle-group-item cu-toggle-group-item-active">List</button>
  <button type="button" class="cu-toggle-group-item">Grid</button>
  <button type="button" class="cu-toggle-group-item">Board</button>
</div>

<!-- Multiple selection -->
<div class="cu-toggle-group cu-toggle-group-multiple" data-cu-toggle-group data-cu-toggle-group-multiple>
  <button type="button" class="cu-toggle-group-item cu-toggle-group-item-active">Bold</button>
  <button type="button" class="cu-toggle-group-item">Italic</button>
```

**Rating** — star rating for reviews and feedback
Classes: `cu-rating`, `cu-rating-item`, `cu-rating-item-active`, `cu-rating-item-half`, `cu-rating-readonly`, `cu-rating-disabled`, `cu-rating-sm`, `cu-rating-lg`
Data: `data-cu-rating`, `data-cu-rating-star="N"` (1-based, star count = number of stars), `data-cu-rating-value="N"` (0 = none), `data-cu-rating-star-text="{value} 顆星"` (optional)
Interactive stars must be `<button type="button">`; `<span>` stars are for read-only display only (`role="img"` + `aria-label` on the root). Fires `cu:rating:change` (`{ value }`) when the user changes the value. Setting `data-cu-rating-value` from code (`el.setAttribute("data-cu-rating-value", "3")`) re-syncs the stars, `aria-checked` and the Tab stop without firing the event; `cu-rating-readonly` / `cu-rating-disabled` can be toggled at any time.
A11y: WAI-ARIA APG rating radio group. JS sets `role="radiogroup"` on the root (name it with `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`; default "Rating") and `role="radio"` + `aria-checked` on each star, with a roving tabindex (one Tab stop: the checked star, or the first star). Keys: Arrow Right / Down = next star, Arrow Left / Up = previous (wrap; mirrored in RTL), Home / End = first / last, Space / Enter = select. Stars are named "1 star" / "N stars"; localize with `data-cu-rating-star-text` on the root (`{value}` = star number), a star's own `aria-label` wins. `cu-rating-readonly` keeps one Tab stop + `aria-readonly`, `cu-rating-disabled` leaves the Tab order + `aria-disabled`. Forced colors (Windows High Contrast): selected stars use the `Highlight` system color, unselected stars are outlines.
```html
<!-- Readonly display -->
<div class="cu-rating cu-rating-readonly" role="img" aria-label="2 out of 3 stars">
  <span class="cu-rating-item cu-rating-item-active"><svg>★</svg></span>
  <span class="cu-rating-item cu-rating-item-active"><svg>★</svg></span>
  <span class="cu-rating-item"><svg>★</svg></span>
</div>

<!-- Interactive -->
<div class="cu-rating" data-cu-rating data-cu-rating-value="0" aria-label="Rate this product">
  <button type="button" class="cu-rating-item" data-cu-rating-star="1"><svg>★</svg></button>
  <button type="button" class="cu-rating-item" data-cu-rating-star="2"><svg>★</svg></button>
  <button type="button" class="cu-rating-item" data-cu-rating-star="3"><svg>★</svg></button>
</div>

<!-- Localized star names -->
<div class="cu-rating" data-cu-rating data-cu-rating-value="0" aria-label="商品評分" data-cu-rating-star-text="{value} 顆星">
  <button type="button" class="cu-rating-item" data-cu-rating-star="1"><svg>★</svg></button>
  <button type="button" class="cu-rating-item" data-cu-rating-star="2"><svg>★</svg></button>
  <button type="button" class="cu-rating-item" data-cu-rating-star="3"><svg>★</svg></button>
</div>
```

**Tag Input** — input for adding/removing tags with keyboard
Classes: `cu-tag-input`, `cu-tag-input-field`, `cu-tag-input-tag`, `cu-tag-input-tag-remove`, `cu-tag-input-primary`, `cu-tag-input-outline`, `cu-tag-input-error`, `cu-tag-input-success`, `cu-tag-input-disabled`
Data: `data-cu-tag-input`, `data-cu-tag-input-field`, `data-cu-tag-max="N"`, `data-cu-tag-value`
```html
<div class="cu-tag-input" data-cu-tag-input>
  <span class="cu-tag-input-tag" data-cu-tag-value="React">
    React
    <button class="cu-tag-input-tag-remove" type="button" aria-label="Remove React">&times;</button>
  </span>
  <input class="cu-tag-input-field" data-cu-tag-input-field placeholder="Add tag..." aria-label="Add tag" />
</div>
```

**Floating Label** — Material Design-style input with floating label
Classes: `cu-floating-label`, `cu-floating-label-input`, `cu-floating-label-text`, `cu-floating-label-textarea`, `cu-floating-label-error`, `cu-floating-label-success`
```html
<div class="cu-floating-label">
  <input id="email" type="email" class="cu-floating-label-input" placeholder=" " />
  <label for="email" class="cu-floating-label-text">Email</label>
</div>
```
Note: Input MUST have `placeholder=" "` (space) for the CSS `:placeholder-shown` selector to work. Link label and input with `for` / `id` so clicking the label focuses the field.

---

### Data Display

**Code Block** — code display with optional header, copy button, and syntax highlighting support
Classes: `cu-code-block` (container, dark bg), `cu-code-block-light` (light bg variant with subtle border), `cu-code-block-header` (top bar with filename/language + copy btn), `cu-code-block-pre` (scrollable code area), `cu-code-block-copy` (copy button, absolute top-right when no header, inline when inside header)
Copy (JS): `data-cu-code-block` on the container + `data-cu-code-block-copy` on the button copies the `cu-code-block-pre` textContent (line breaks preserved) via the Clipboard API, falling back to `execCommand("copy")`. Optional on the container: `data-cu-code-block-success-text` (default "Copied!"), `data-cu-code-block-error-text` (default "Copy failed"); a `data-cu-code-block-label` child shows the message and is restored after 2000 ms.
States (on the button): `data-cu-copied` (success), `data-cu-copy-failed` (Clipboard API unavailable / denied and fallback failed). Events: `cu:code-block:copy` (detail.text), `cu:code-block:error` (detail.error), both bubble. A11y: messages are announced via the visually hidden `role="status"` region shared with Copy Button (`data-cu-copy-live`).
Syntax highlighting: add `language-xxx` class on `<code>` element to enable third-party highlighting (Prism.js / Highlight.js).
```html
<div class="cu-code-block">
  <div class="cu-code-block-header">
    <span>index.js</span>
    <button class="cu-code-block-copy">Copy</button>
  </div>
  <pre class="cu-code-block-pre"><code class="language-javascript">const x = 42;</code></pre>
</div>

<!-- Light variant -->
<div class="cu-code-block cu-code-block-light">
  <button class="cu-code-block-copy">Copy</button>
  <pre class="cu-code-block-pre"><code>npm install cubby-ui</code></pre>
</div>
```

**Chart** — wrapper styles for charts drawn by an external library (Chart.js, ECharts, …) or inline SVG; no charting JS is shipped
Classes: `cu-chart` (card), `cu-chart-flat`, `cu-chart-ghost`, `cu-chart-header`, `cu-chart-header-content`, `cu-chart-title`, `cu-chart-description`, `cu-chart-value` (headline number), `cu-chart-actions`, `cu-chart-body`, `cu-chart-body-split` (canvas + legend side by side), `cu-chart-canvas` (relative, h-64), `cu-chart-canvas-sm` (h-48) / `cu-chart-canvas-lg` (h-80) / `cu-chart-canvas-square` (pie / donut), `cu-chart-footer`
Legend: `cu-chart-legend` (+ `-center` / `-vertical`), `cu-chart-legend-item` (as `<button aria-pressed>` for toggling), `cu-chart-legend-item-inactive`, `cu-chart-legend-value`, `cu-chart-swatch` (+ `-dot` / `-line`)
Colors: `cu-chart-color-1` … `cu-chart-color-5` set `currentColor` from `--color-chart-1` … `--color-chart-5` (use on swatches and SVG marks with `fill="currentColor"` / `stroke="currentColor"`)
Tooltip: `cu-chart-tooltip`, `cu-chart-tooltip-label`, `cu-chart-tooltip-item`, `cu-chart-tooltip-value` (unpositioned; set left/top in your library's tooltip callback)
Inline SVG helpers: `cu-chart-grid` (dashed gridline), `cu-chart-axis-line` (baseline), `cu-chart-axis` (tick labels)
States (inside `cu-chart-canvas`): `cu-chart-empty` + `cu-chart-empty-title` / `cu-chart-empty-description`; `cu-chart-loading` + `cu-chart-loading-bar` (set `aria-busy="true"` on the canvas)
Chart.js: `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--color-chart-1")`, `maintainAspectRatio: false`, `plugins.legend.display: false`; re-apply colors when `.dark` toggles.
```html
<div class="cu-chart">
  <div class="cu-chart-header">
    <div class="cu-chart-header-content">
      <h3 class="cu-chart-title">Visitors</h3>
      <p class="cu-chart-description">January – June 2026</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-chart-body">
    <div class="cu-chart-canvas">
      <canvas id="visitors-chart" role="img" aria-label="Monthly visitors by device"></canvas>
    </div>
    <div class="cu-chart-legend cu-chart-legend-center">
      <span class="cu-chart-legend-item"><span class="cu-chart-swatch cu-chart-color-1"></span>Desktop</span>
      <span class="cu-chart-legend-item"><span class="cu-chart-swatch cu-chart-color-2"></span>Mobile</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Accordion** ⚡ CSS-driven (open/close via HTML `open` attribute on `<details>`)

Variants: `cu-sortable-list-bordered` (shared border), `cu-sortable-list-compact` (tighter spacing), `cu-sortable-list-card` (elevated card style with shadow), `cu-sortable-list-ghost` (no border, hover-only background), `cu-sortable-list-striped` (alternating row backgrounds), `cu-sortable-list-numbered` (auto counter badges via CSS counter)

**Tree View** — `cu-tree`, `cu-tree-item` (`<details>`), `cu-tree-trigger` (`<summary>`), `cu-tree-trigger-icon`, `cu-tree-content`, `cu-tree-leaf`, `cu-tree-leaf-active`, `cu-tree-relaxed`. Uses native `<details>`/`<summary>` for expand/collapse. `cu-tree-relaxed` adds slightly more spacing between items and within nodes.
```html
<div class="cu-tree">

</div>
```

**Data Table** — `cu-data-table`, `cu-data-table-check`, `cu-data-table-toolbar`, `cu-data-table-head-sortable`, `cu-data-table-head-sorted-asc/desc`, `cu-data-table-row-selected`, `cu-data-table-striped`, `cu-data-table-info`. Enhanced table with sorting, filtering, row selection. `cu-data-table-check` centers checkbox in narrow column.
Expandable rows: `cu-data-table-expand-trigger` (row expand/collapse trigger), `cu-data-table-expanded-row` (active parent row state), `cu-data-table-expanded-content` (expanded content area)
Data attributes: `data-cu-data-table-expandable` (on table container), `data-cu-expand-row` (on expand trigger; toggles the `<tr>` immediately after the trigger's row)
Sorting, filtering and row selection are styling only (`cu-data-table-head-sorted-asc/desc`, `cu-data-table-row-selected`) — cubby-ui.js does not sort or select rows; wire them up in your own code.
```html
<div class="cu-data-table cu-data-table-striped">
  <div class="cu-table-wrapper">
    <table class="cu-table">
      <thead><tr><th class="cu-table-head cu-data-table-head-sortable">Name</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody><tr><td class="cu-table-cell">Row</td></tr></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Expandable rows -->
<div class="cu-data-table" data-cu-data-table-expandable>
  <div class="cu-table-wrapper">
    <table class="cu-table">
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="cu-table-cell">
            <button type="button" class="cu-data-table-expand-trigger" data-cu-expand-row aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Show details"><svg aria-hidden="true"><!-- chevron --></svg></button>
          </td>
          <td class="cu-table-cell">#1001</td>
        </tr>
        <tr hidden>
          <td colspan="2" class="cu-data-table-expanded-content">Order details…</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Table**
Responsive: Add `cu-table-stacked` to wrapper + `data-label` on each `<td>` for mobile card layout (≤640px).
```html
<div class="cu-table-wrapper">
  <table class="cu-table">
    <thead><tr><th>Name</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody><tr><td data-label="Name">Row</td></tr></tbody>
  </table>
</div>
```

**Setting Item** — `cu-setting-item`, `cu-setting-item-content`, `cu-setting-item-label`, `cu-setting-item-description`, `cu-setting-item-action`, `cu-setting-item-icon`. `cu-setting-item-icon` adds a leading icon container (rounded, muted background).
```html
<div class="cu-setting-item">
  <div class="cu-setting-item-content">
    <p class="cu-setting-item-label">Setting Name</p>
    <p class="cu-setting-item-description">Description text</p>
```

### Content

**Carousel** ⚡ Interactive — horizontal slide carousel with snap scrolling
Classes: `cu-carousel` (container), `cu-carousel-viewport` (scroll container, snap-x), `cu-carousel-slide` (each slide, snap-start), `cu-carousel-multi-2` / `cu-carousel-multi-3` (show 2 or 3 slides at a time, add on carousel container), `cu-carousel-nav-outside` (place arrows outside viewport, add on carousel container), `cu-carousel-prev` / `cu-carousel-next` (arrow buttons, absolute center-y), `cu-carousel-dots` (dot indicators container), `cu-carousel-dot` (individual dot), `cu-carousel-dot-active` (active dot, primary color)
Data attributes (all required for JS — without `data-cu-carousel-viewport` / `data-cu-carousel-slide` the carousel is not initialized): `data-cu-carousel` (container), `data-cu-carousel-viewport`, `data-cu-carousel-slide`, `data-cu-carousel-prev`, `data-cu-carousel-next`, `data-cu-carousel-dot`
```html
<div class="cu-carousel" data-cu-carousel>
  <div class="cu-carousel-viewport" data-cu-carousel-viewport>
    <div class="cu-carousel-slide" data-cu-carousel-slide>Slide 1</div>
    <div class="cu-carousel-slide" data-cu-carousel-slide>Slide 2</div>
    <div class="cu-carousel-slide" data-cu-carousel-slide>Slide 3</div>
  </div>
  <button type="button" class="cu-carousel-prev" data-cu-carousel-prev aria-label="Previous">‹</button>
  <button type="button" class="cu-carousel-next" data-cu-carousel-next aria-label="Next">›</button>
  <div class="cu-carousel-dots">
    <button type="button" class="cu-carousel-dot cu-carousel-dot-active" data-cu-carousel-dot aria-label="Slide 1"></button>
    <button type="button" class="cu-carousel-dot" data-cu-carousel-dot aria-label="Slide 2"></button>
    <button type="button" class="cu-carousel-dot" data-cu-carousel-dot aria-label="Slide 3"></button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Countdown** — countdown timer to a target date
Classes: `cu-countdown`, `cu-countdown-segment`, `cu-countdown-value`, `cu-countdown-label`, `cu-countdown-separator`, `cu-countdown-sm`, `cu-countdown-lg`, `cu-countdown-flush`, `cu-countdown-complete`

```html
<div class="cu-countdown" data-cu-countdown data-cu-countdown-target="2026-12-31T00:00:00">

```

**Diff Viewer** — code diff display (unified or side-by-side)
Classes: `cu-diff-viewer`, `cu-diff-viewer-header`, `cu-diff-viewer-filename`, `cu-diff-viewer-hunk`, `cu-diff-viewer-line`, `cu-diff-viewer-line-number`, `cu-diff-viewer-line-content`, `cu-diff-viewer-line-added`, `cu-diff-viewer-line-removed`, `cu-diff-viewer-line-unchanged`, `cu-diff-viewer-side-by-side`, `cu-diff-viewer-side`, `cu-diff-viewer-word-added`, `cu-diff-viewer-word-removed`
```html
<div class="cu-diff-viewer">
  <div class="cu-diff-viewer-header">
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-filename">src/app.js</span>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-diff-viewer-hunk">@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@</div>
  <div class="cu-diff-viewer-line cu-diff-viewer-line-unchanged">
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-number">1</span>
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-content">import React from 'react';</span>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-diff-viewer-line cu-diff-viewer-line-removed">
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-number">2</span>
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-content">const App = () => null;</span>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-diff-viewer-line cu-diff-viewer-line-added">
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-number">2</span>
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-content">const App = () => &lt;div&gt;Hello&lt;/div&gt;;</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Image Compare** — before/after image comparison slider
Classes: `cu-image-compare`, `cu-image-compare-before`, `cu-image-compare-after`, `cu-image-compare-handle`, `cu-image-compare-handle-line`, `cu-image-compare-handle-grip`, `cu-image-compare-label`, `cu-image-compare-vertical`
Data: `data-cu-image-compare`, `data-cu-image-compare-position="N"` (initial position 0–100, default 50)
Keyboard (set by JS): the handle becomes `role="slider"` (`tabindex="0"`, `aria-valuenow` 0–100, `aria-valuetext="N%"`, `aria-orientation`); Arrow keys ±1, Page Up / Page Down ±10, Home / End → 0 / 100 (vertical: Down / Right increase). Name it with `aria-label` on the handle (default "Image comparison").
```html
<div class="cu-image-compare" data-cu-image-compare data-cu-image-compare-position="50">
  <img class="cu-image-compare-after" src="after.jpg" alt="After" />
  <img class="cu-image-compare-before" src="before.jpg" alt="Before" />
  <div class="cu-image-compare-handle">
    <div class="cu-image-compare-handle-line"></div>
    <div class="cu-image-compare-handle-grip">⇔</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Marquee** — infinitely scrolling content (logo walls, testimonials). Pure CSS.

### Feedback

**Alert**
Variants: `cu-alert-default`, `cu-alert-destructive`, `cu-alert-success`, `cu-alert-warning`, `cu-alert-info`
Modifier: `cu-alert-accent` (prominent filled emphasis: full border + tinted background)
Expandable: `cu-alert-expandable-content` (expandable content area), `cu-alert-expand-trigger` (expand toggle button)
Data attributes: `data-cu-alert-expandable` (on container), `data-cu-alert-expand-trigger` (on toggle button), `data-cu-alert-expandable-content` (on content area; the single child `<div>` is what collapses)
```html
<div class="cu-alert cu-alert-success">
  <div class="cu-alert-title">Success</div>
  <div class="cu-alert-description">Operation completed.</div>
</div>

<!-- Expandable -->
<div class="cu-alert cu-alert-info" data-cu-alert-expandable>
  <div>
    <h5 class="cu-alert-title">Update available</h5>
    <p class="cu-alert-description">A new version is available.</p>
    <button type="button" class="cu-alert-expand-trigger" data-cu-alert-expand-trigger aria-expanded="false">Show details</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-alert-expandable-content" data-cu-alert-expandable-content>
    <div>Release notes…</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Progress**
Modifiers: `cu-progress-bar-striped`, `cu-progress-bar-striped-animated`, `cu-progress-bar-gradient`
Multi-segment: `cu-progress-multi` (container for multiple `cu-progress-bar` segments side by side)
Circular progress: `cu-progress-circular` (SVG container), `cu-progress-circular-track` (background track), `cu-progress-circular-bar` (progress bar stroke), `cu-progress-circular-value` (centered value label)
Circular color variants: `cu-progress-circular-bar-success`, `cu-progress-circular-bar-warning`, `cu-progress-circular-bar-destructive`, `cu-progress-circular-bar-info`
Circular animation: `cu-progress-circular-indeterminate` (spinning animation)
```html
<div class="cu-progress">
  <div class="cu-progress-bar" style="width: 60%"></div>
</div>
```

**Skeleton**

```html
<div class="cu-skeleton" style="width: 200px; height: 20px"></div>
```

**Spinner**
Sizes: `cu-spinner-sm` (16px), `cu-spinner-md` (24px), `cu-spinner-lg` (32px, thicker border)

```html
<div class="cu-spinner cu-spinner-md"></div>
<div class="cu-spinner cu-spinner-lg cu-spinner-primary"></div>
```

```html
<div class="cu-empty-state">

  <div class="cu-empty-state-description">Get started by adding an item.</div>
```

**Notification** — static notification cards for activity feeds and panels
Classes: `cu-notification`, `cu-notification-icon`, `cu-notification-content`, `cu-notification-title`, `cu-notification-description`, `cu-notification-time`, `cu-notification-actions`, `cu-notification-close`, `cu-notification-unread`, `cu-notification-list`
Variants: `cu-notification-info`, `cu-notification-success`, `cu-notification-warning`, `cu-notification-destructive`
```html
<div class="cu-notification cu-notification-unread">
  <div class="cu-notification-icon">🔔</div>
  <div class="cu-notification-content">
    <div class="cu-notification-title">New message</div>
    <div class="cu-notification-description">You have a new message from Alex.</div>
    <div class="cu-notification-time">2 min ago</div>
  </div>
  <button class="cu-notification-close">&times;</button>
</div>
```

**Toast** ⚡ Interactive — triggered by button click, auto-dismissed
Variants: `cu-toast-default`, `cu-toast-destructive`, `cu-toast-success`, `cu-toast-warning`, `cu-toast-info`
Toast container is auto-created if missing. Customize with `data-cu-toast-container` attributes.
```html
<!-- Trigger button -->
<button class="cu-button cu-button-default"
  data-cu-toast-trigger
  data-cu-toast-title="Saved!"
  data-cu-toast-description="Your changes have been saved."
  data-cu-toast-variant="success"
  data-cu-toast-duration="4000">
  Save
</button>

<!-- Optional: explicit container (auto-created at bottom-right if omitted) -->
<div class="cu-toast-container cu-toast-container-bottom-right"
  data-cu-toast-container
  data-cu-toast-max="5">
</div>
```
Container position variants: `cu-toast-container-top-right`, `cu-toast-container-top-left`, `cu-toast-container-bottom-right`, `cu-toast-container-bottom-left`, `cu-toast-container-top-center`, `cu-toast-container-bottom-center`
Action classes: `cu-toast-action` (action button container), `cu-toast-action-btn` (action button styling)
Duration: `data-cu-toast-duration` on the trigger (ms, default 5000; `"0"` keeps the toast until dismissed).
A11y: toasts use `role="status"` (`role="alert"` for destructive). Generated close buttons are named "Close"; localize with `data-cu-toast-close-text="關閉通知"` on the container.
Programmatic API: `CubbyUI.toast.show({ title, description, variant, duration, action })` — show a toast via JS (returns the toast element). `action: { label, onClick(event, toast) }` renders a `cu-toast-action-btn`; the toast closes after `onClick` unless it calls `event.preventDefault()`. `CubbyUI.toast.promise(promise, { loading, success, error })` — bind toast states to a Promise lifecycle.

### Overlay

**Command Palette** ⚡ Interactive — keyboard-driven command search overlay, uses native `<dialog>`
Classes: `cu-command` (dialog container, centered, max-w-lg), `cu-command-input-wrapper` (search bar row with border-bottom), `cu-command-input-icon` (search icon), `cu-command-input` (text input), `cu-command-list` (scrollable results), `cu-command-group` (group container), `cu-command-group-heading` (group label), `cu-command-item` (selectable row), `cu-command-separator` (divider), `cu-command-shortcut` (right-aligned shortcut text), `cu-command-empty` (no results message)
Active item: `data-cu-command-active` attribute highlights item.
A11y (APG combobox + listbox, set by JS): input `role="combobox"` + `aria-controls` / `aria-autocomplete="list"` / `aria-expanded="true"` / `aria-activedescendant` (active item); list `role="listbox"`, groups `role="group"` labelled by their `cu-command-group-heading`, items `role="option"` + `aria-selected` (ids auto-generated). Items may be `<a href>`: Enter still clicks (navigates) the active item.
Data attributes (required for filtering / keyboard navigation): `data-cu-command` (on `<dialog>`), `data-cu-command-input`, `data-cu-command-list`, `data-cu-command-group`, `data-cu-command-item` (optional `data-cu-command-value` = search text), `data-cu-command-separator`, `data-cu-command-empty` (add `hidden`; shown when nothing matches). Open with `data-cu-command-trigger="<dialog id>"` on a button or Ctrl / Cmd + K. Items are queried on demand — items added to / removed from `data-cu-command-list` after init (e.g. remote search results) are filtered, navigable and get ARIA immediately; `CubbyUI.refresh()` re-syncs them too.
```html
<button type="button" class="cu-button cu-button-outline" data-cu-command-trigger="command-menu">Search… <kbd class="cu-kbd cu-kbd-sm">⌘K</kbd></button>

<dialog id="command-menu" class="cu-command" data-cu-command aria-label="Command menu">
  <div class="cu-command-input-wrapper">
    <svg class="cu-command-input-icon" aria-hidden="true"><!-- search icon --></svg>
    <input class="cu-command-input" data-cu-command-input placeholder="Type a command or search..." aria-label="Search commands">
  </div>
  <div class="cu-command-list" data-cu-command-list>
    <div class="cu-command-group" data-cu-command-group>
      <div class="cu-command-group-heading">Suggestions</div>
      <button type="button" class="cu-command-item" data-cu-command-item>
        Calendar
        <span class="cu-command-shortcut"><kbd class="cu-kbd cu-kbd-sm">⌘K</kbd></span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="cu-command-item" data-cu-command-item>Search</button>
    </div>
    <div class="cu-command-separator" data-cu-command-separator></div>
    <div class="cu-command-group" data-cu-command-group>
      <div class="cu-command-group-heading">Settings</div>
      <button type="button" class="cu-command-item" data-cu-command-item data-cu-command-value="profile account">Profile</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-command-empty" data-cu-command-empty hidden>No results found.</div>
</dialog>
```

**Context Menu** ⚡ Interactive — right-click triggered menu
Classes: `cu-context-menu` (wrapper), `cu-context-menu-content` (popup panel, reuses dropdown item styles)
Menu items use `cu-dropdown-item`, `cu-dropdown-label`, `cu-dropdown-separator` classes.
Data attributes: `data-cu-context-menu`, `data-cu-context-menu-content`
Keyboard (set by JS): the container becomes focusable (`tabindex="0"` unless it already has a `tabindex`; `-1` lets focusable children receive the shortcut); Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key opens the menu at the focused element with the first item highlighted. The menu is `role="menu"` (takes focus, `aria-activedescendant` → highlighted `cu-dropdown-item-highlight`), items `role="menuitem"`, separators `role="separator"`; ↑ / ↓ wrap, Home / End, Enter / Space activate, Esc / Tab close, focus returns. Name the container with `aria-label`.
```html
<div class="cu-context-menu" data-cu-context-menu aria-label="Clipboard actions">
  <div>Right-click this area</div>
  <div class="cu-context-menu-content" data-cu-context-menu-content hidden>
    <button class="cu-dropdown-item">Cut</button>
    <button class="cu-dropdown-item">Copy</button>
    <button class="cu-dropdown-item">Paste</button>
    <div class="cu-dropdown-separator"></div>
    <button class="cu-dropdown-item">Delete</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Dialog** ⚡ Interactive — uses native `<dialog>` element
Sizes: `cu-dialog-sm`, `cu-dialog-md` (default), `cu-dialog-xl`, `cu-dialog-full`
Scrollable layout: `cu-dialog-body` (flex column with max-height), `cu-dialog-scroll` (scrollable content area)
Trigger attribute value must match `<dialog id="...">`, and the `<dialog>` itself needs `data-cu-dialog` (otherwise `data-cu-dialog-close` buttons do nothing and the title / description are not linked via `aria-labelledby` / `aria-describedby`).
```html
<!-- Trigger -->
<button class="cu-button cu-button-default" data-cu-dialog-trigger="my-dialog">Open</button>

<!-- Dialog -->
<dialog id="my-dialog" class="cu-dialog" data-cu-dialog>
  <div class="cu-dialog-header">
    <h2 class="cu-dialog-title">Dialog Title</h2>
    <p class="cu-dialog-description">Description text.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-dialog-footer">
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline" data-cu-dialog-close>Cancel</button>
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-default">Confirm</button>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

**Drawer** ⚡ Interactive — side panel, uses native `<dialog>`
Directions: `cu-drawer-right` (default), `cu-drawer-left`, `cu-drawer-top`, `cu-drawer-bottom`
The `<dialog>` needs `data-cu-drawer` (otherwise `data-cu-drawer-close` buttons do nothing).
```html
<button data-cu-drawer-trigger="my-drawer" class="cu-button cu-button-default">Open Drawer</button>

<dialog id="my-drawer" class="cu-drawer cu-drawer-right" data-cu-drawer>
  <div class="cu-drawer-header">
    <h2 class="cu-drawer-title">Drawer Title</h2>
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-ghost cu-button-icon" data-cu-drawer-close aria-label="Close">✕</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-drawer-content">Content</div>
  <div class="cu-drawer-footer">
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline" data-cu-drawer-close>Close</button>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

**Alert Dialog** ⚡ Interactive — blocking confirmation, uses native `<dialog>`
Closes on cancel or action buttons (NOT on backdrop click). The `<dialog>` needs `data-cu-alert-dialog` (sets `role="alertdialog"` and wires the cancel / action buttons).
```html
<button data-cu-alert-dialog-trigger="confirm-dialog" class="cu-button cu-button-destructive">Delete</button>

<dialog id="confirm-dialog" class="cu-alert-dialog" data-cu-alert-dialog>
  <div class="cu-alert-dialog-header">
    <h2 class="cu-alert-dialog-title">Are you sure?</h2>
    <p class="cu-alert-dialog-description">This action cannot be undone.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-alert-dialog-footer">
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline" data-cu-alert-dialog-cancel>Cancel</button>
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-destructive" data-cu-alert-dialog-action>Delete</button>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

**Menubar** ⚡ Interactive — top-level menu bar with sub-menus
```html

  <div class="cu-menubar-menu" data-cu-menubar-menu>
    <button class="cu-menubar-trigger" data-cu-menubar-trigger>File</button>
    <div class="cu-menubar-content" data-cu-menubar-content hidden>
      <button class="cu-menubar-item">New</button>
      <button class="cu-menubar-item">Open</button>
      <div class="cu-menubar-separator"></div>
      <button class="cu-menubar-item">
        Save <span class="cu-menubar-shortcut">⌘S</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Tour** ⚡ Interactive — guided tour overlay with spotlight highlighting
Classes: `cu-tour-overlay`, `cu-tour-spotlight`, `cu-tour-tooltip`, `cu-tour-tooltip-title`, `cu-tour-tooltip-description`, `cu-tour-tooltip-footer`, `cu-tour-tooltip-progress`, `cu-tour-tooltip-actions`, `cu-tour-dots`, `cu-tour-dot`, `cu-tour-dot-active`, `cu-tour-target`
Data: `data-cu-tour`, `data-cu-tour-steps` (JSON array; each step `{ "target": CSS selector, "title", "description", "placement": top|bottom|left|right }` — the text key is `description`), `data-cu-tour-auto` (start on load)
There is no declarative trigger attribute: start the tour with `data-cu-tour-auto` or by dispatching `cu:tour:start` on the `[data-cu-tour]` element. Fires `cu:tour:complete` when finished.
```html
<h2 id="step1">Dashboard</h2>
<nav id="step2" class="cu-nav"><a class="cu-nav-item" href="#">Reports</a></nav>
<button type="button" id="start-tour" class="cu-button cu-button-outline">Start tour</button>

<div id="tour" data-cu-tour data-cu-tour-steps='[
  {"target": "#step1", "title": "Welcome", "description": "This is the first step.", "placement": "bottom"},
  {"target": "#step2", "title": "Features", "description": "Explore our features.", "placement": "right"}
]'>
</div>
<script>
  document.getElementById("start-tour").addEventListener("click", function () {
    document.getElementById("tour").dispatchEvent(new Event("cu:tour:start"));
  });
</script>
```

---

### Navigation

**Tabs** ⚡ Interactive — show/hide panels
Active trigger: `cu-tabs-trigger-active`
List variants: `cu-tabs-list-pills` (pill-shaped tab bar), `cu-tabs-list-underline` (underline-only, transparent background), `cu-tabs-list-vertical` (vertical column list — use with `cu-tabs-vertical` on the root container for side-by-side layout)
Tab extras: `cu-tabs-trigger-badge` (badge inside tab trigger), `cu-tabs-trigger-close` (close icon inside tab trigger — `<span class="cu-tabs-trigger-close" data-cu-tabs-close aria-hidden="true">×</span>`, a mouse target, never a nested button; Delete / Backspace on the focused tab closes it, `aria-keyshortcuts="Delete"` is set by JS; focus / selection move to the following tab, or the previous one; fires `cu:tabs:close`)
Scrollable: `cu-tabs-list-scrollable` (scrollable wrapper), `cu-tabs-scroll-btn` (scroll left button), `cu-tabs-scroll-btn-end` (scroll right button)
Data attributes: `data-cu-tabs-close` (on the close icon), `data-cu-tabs-scrollable` (on scrollable wrapper)
Keyboard (APG Tabs, automatic activation, set by JS): only the selected tab is in the Tab order (roving `tabindex`); Arrow keys move focus and select the next / previous tab (wrapping; Left / Right swapped in RTL), Home / End jump to the first / last; `disabled` / `aria-disabled="true"` tabs are skipped. A list laid out as a column (`cu-tabs-list-vertical`, including when it switches at a breakpoint) uses Up / Down, and `aria-orientation` follows the current layout.
```html
<div class="cu-tabs" data-cu-tabs>
  <div class="cu-tabs-list">
    <button class="cu-tabs-trigger cu-tabs-trigger-active" data-cu-tabs-trigger="tab1">Tab 1</button>
    <button class="cu-tabs-trigger" data-cu-tabs-trigger="tab2">Tab 2</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-tabs-content" data-cu-tabs-content="tab1">Panel 1</div>
  <div class="cu-tabs-content" data-cu-tabs-content="tab2" hidden>Panel 2</div>
</div>
```

**Breadcrumb**
Collapsed items: `cu-breadcrumb-ellipsis` (clickable ellipsis for collapsed breadcrumb items)
```html
<nav class="cu-breadcrumb">
  <ol>
    <li class="cu-breadcrumb-item">
      <a href="/" class="cu-breadcrumb-link">Home</a>
    </li>
    <li class="cu-breadcrumb-separator">/</li>
    <li class="cu-breadcrumb-item">
      <span class="cu-breadcrumb-current">Current Page</span>
    </li>
  </ol>
</nav>
```

**Pagination**
Active: `cu-pagination-item-active`
```html
<nav class="cu-pagination">
  <a href="#" class="cu-pagination-prev">Previous</a>
  <a href="#" class="cu-pagination-item cu-pagination-item-active">1</a>
  <a href="#" class="cu-pagination-item">2</a>
  <span class="cu-pagination-ellipsis">…</span>
  <a href="#" class="cu-pagination-next">Next</a>
</nav>
```

**Segmented Control** ⚡ Interactive
Active: `cu-segmented-item-active`
Sizes: `cu-segmented-sm`; full-width: add `cu-segmented-block`
Data: `data-cu-segmented` (on the container — JS moves `cu-segmented-item-active` on click). Radio mode: hidden `cu-segmented-input` radios, each followed by a `<label class="cu-segmented-item" for="...">` (the label must point at its radio, otherwise clicking it does nothing).
```html
<div class="cu-segmented" data-cu-segmented>
  <button type="button" class="cu-segmented-item cu-segmented-item-active">Day</button>
  <button type="button" class="cu-segmented-item">Week</button>
  <button type="button" class="cu-segmented-item">Month</button>
</div>

<!-- Radio mode (form value, arrow-key navigation) -->
<div class="cu-segmented" data-cu-segmented>
  <input type="radio" name="view" value="list" id="view-list" class="cu-segmented-input" checked>
  <label for="view-list" class="cu-segmented-item">List</label>
  <input type="radio" name="view" value="grid" id="view-grid" class="cu-segmented-input">
  <label for="view-grid" class="cu-segmented-item">Grid</label>
</div>
```

**Steps** — progress indicator for multi-step workflows
Classes: `cu-steps`, `cu-steps-item`, `cu-steps-number`, `cu-steps-content`, `cu-steps-title`, `cu-steps-description`, `cu-steps-separator`
States: `cu-steps-item-completed`, `cu-steps-item-active`, `cu-steps-item-upcoming`, `cu-steps-item-error`
Modifiers: `cu-steps-vertical` (vertical layout)
A `cu-steps-separator` that directly follows a `cu-steps-item-completed` item turns `bg-primary` automatically.
```html
<div class="cu-steps">
  <div class="cu-steps-item cu-steps-item-completed">
    <div class="cu-steps-number">✓</div>
    <div class="cu-steps-content"><div class="cu-steps-title">Account</div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-steps-separator"></div>
  <div class="cu-steps-item cu-steps-item-active">
    <div class="cu-steps-number">2</div>
    <div class="cu-steps-content"><div class="cu-steps-title">Profile</div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-steps-separator"></div>
  <div class="cu-steps-item cu-steps-item-upcoming">
    <div class="cu-steps-number">3</div>
    <div class="cu-steps-content"><div class="cu-steps-title">Complete</div></div>
  </div>
</div>
```
Vertical layout:
```html
<div class="cu-steps cu-steps-vertical">
  <div class="cu-steps-item cu-steps-item-completed">
    <div class="cu-steps-number">✓</div>
    <div class="cu-steps-content">
      <div class="cu-steps-title">Order placed</div>
      <div class="cu-steps-description">Your order has been confirmed</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-steps-separator"></div>
  <div class="cu-steps-item cu-steps-item-active">
    <div class="cu-steps-number">2</div>
    <div class="cu-steps-content"><div class="cu-steps-title">Shipping</div></div>
  </div>
</div>
```
Error state: use `cu-steps-item-error` on the item for destructive styling.

**Menubar** — see Overlay section above.

**Speed Dial** — floating action button with expandable actions
Classes: `cu-speed-dial`, `cu-speed-dial-trigger`, `cu-speed-dial-actions`, `cu-speed-dial-action`, `cu-speed-dial-action-btn`, `cu-speed-dial-action-label`, `cu-speed-dial-sm`, `cu-speed-dial-horizontal`
Positions: `cu-speed-dial-bottom-right`, `cu-speed-dial-bottom-left`, `cu-speed-dial-top-right`, `cu-speed-dial-top-left`
Data: `data-cu-speed-dial`, `data-cu-speed-dial-trigger`, `data-cu-speed-dial-actions`
```html
<div class="cu-speed-dial cu-speed-dial-bottom-right" data-cu-speed-dial>
  <div class="cu-speed-dial-actions" data-cu-speed-dial-actions>
    <div class="cu-speed-dial-action">
      <span class="cu-speed-dial-action-label">Edit</span>
      <button class="cu-speed-dial-action-btn">✏️</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <button class="cu-speed-dial-trigger" data-cu-speed-dial-trigger>+</button>
</div>
```

**Back to Top** — scroll-to-top button that appears after scrolling
Classes: `cu-back-to-top`, `cu-back-to-top-primary`, `cu-back-to-top-sm`, `cu-back-to-top-lg`
Visible state (JS-toggled): `cu-back-to-top-visible` class or `data-cu-visible` attribute
Data: `data-cu-back-to-top`, `data-cu-back-to-top-threshold="300"`
```html
<button class="cu-back-to-top" data-cu-back-to-top data-cu-back-to-top-threshold="300" aria-label="Back to top">
  <svg><!-- chevron up --></svg>
</button>
```

### Layout

**Kanban** ⚡ Interactive — drag-and-drop board with columns and cards
Classes: `cu-kanban`, `cu-kanban-column`, `cu-kanban-column-header`, `cu-kanban-column-title`, `cu-kanban-column-count`, `cu-kanban-column-body`, `cu-kanban-card`, `cu-kanban-card-title`, `cu-kanban-card-description`, `cu-kanban-card-footer`, `cu-kanban-card-tag`, `cu-kanban-compact`, `cu-kanban-add`
Data: `data-cu-kanban`, `data-cu-kanban-column`, `data-cu-kanban-column-body`, `data-cu-kanban-card`
```html
<div class="cu-kanban" data-cu-kanban>
  <div class="cu-kanban-column" data-cu-kanban-column>
    <div class="cu-kanban-column-header">
      <span class="cu-kanban-column-title">To Do</span>
      <span class="cu-kanban-column-count">2</span>
    </div>
    <div class="cu-kanban-column-body" data-cu-kanban-column-body>
      <div class="cu-kanban-card" data-cu-kanban-card draggable="true">
        <div class="cu-kanban-card-title">Design mockups</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Container**
Sizes: `cu-container-sm`, `cu-container-md`, `cu-container-lg`, `cu-container-xl`, `cu-container-2xl`, `cu-container-prose`
```html
<div class="cu-container cu-container-xl">Page content</div>
```

**Header**
```html
<header class="cu-header">
  <div class="cu-header-inner">
    <div class="cu-header-brand"><!-- logo --></div>
    <nav class="cu-header-nav cu-header-nav-md"><!-- nav items --></nav>
    <div class="cu-header-actions">
      <!-- buttons -->
      <button data-cu-mobile-nav-trigger="main-nav" class="cu-button cu-button-ghost cu-button-icon-sm cu-header-mobile-toggle-md" aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false">☰</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>
<!-- Mobile nav backdrop + panel (hidden attr prevents FOUC; -md removes them on desktop) -->
<div id="main-nav" class="cu-header-mobile-backdrop cu-header-mobile-backdrop-md" data-cu-mobile-nav hidden></div>
<nav id="main-nav-panel" class="cu-header-mobile-nav cu-header-mobile-nav-md"
     data-cu-mobile-nav-panel="main-nav" data-cu-mobile-nav-clone
     role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Navigation menu" hidden>
  <div class="cu-header-mobile-header">
    <button data-cu-mobile-nav-close class="cu-header-mobile-close" aria-label="Close menu">✕</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-header-mobile-content"><!-- auto-cloned from cu-header-nav --></div>
</nav>
```
Nav breakpoint modifiers: `cu-header-nav-sm`, `cu-header-nav-md`, `cu-header-nav-lg`, `cu-header-nav-xl` — hide nav below that breakpoint (cu-header-nav alone is always visible)
Nav alignment variants: `cu-header-nav-start` (left, next to brand), `cu-header-nav-end` (right, next to actions)
Mobile nav classes: `cu-header-mobile-nav` (right-side slide-in panel, w-72), `cu-header-mobile-backdrop` (overlay, bg-foreground/30), `cu-header-mobile-header` (justify-end), `cu-header-mobile-content`, `cu-header-mobile-close`
Mobile nav breakpoint removal: `cu-header-mobile-nav-{sm|md|lg|xl}` + `cu-header-mobile-backdrop-{sm|md|lg|xl}` — fully hide (display:none) panel/backdrop at/above that breakpoint; match the trigger's breakpoint (default md)
Mobile nav trigger: `cu-header-mobile-toggle-{sm|md|lg|xl}` on the hamburger button hides it at/above that breakpoint (plain CSS — do not rely on Tailwind's `md:hidden`, which is not in the prebuilt CSS); omit it for an always-visible trigger
Mobile nav behavior: panel/backdrop are display:none when closed (removed from a11y tree, animated open via @starting-style + allow-discrete); add the `hidden` attribute to both by default to prevent FOUC before CSS loads (JS strips it on open)
Mobile nav attrs: `data-cu-mobile-nav-trigger="id"`, `data-cu-mobile-nav`, `data-cu-mobile-nav-panel="id"`, `data-cu-mobile-nav-close`, `data-cu-mobile-nav-clone` (auto-clone desktop nav)

**Nav**
Active: `cu-nav-item-active`
Disabled: `cu-nav-item-disabled`
Vertical: add `cu-nav-vertical` to container
```html
<nav class="cu-nav">
  <a href="/" class="cu-nav-item cu-nav-item-active">Home</a>
  <a href="/about" class="cu-nav-item">About</a>
</nav>
```

**Sidebar**
```html
<aside class="cu-sidebar">
  <div class="cu-sidebar-header">Brand / Logo</div>
  <div class="cu-sidebar-content">
    <div class="cu-sidebar-section">
      <div class="cu-sidebar-section-title">SECTION</div>
      <div class="cu-sidebar-group">
        <div class="cu-sidebar-group-title">Group</div>
        <a href="#" class="cu-sidebar-item cu-sidebar-item-active">Active Link</a>
        <a href="#" class="cu-sidebar-item">Link</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <hr class="cu-sidebar-separator">
  </div>
  <div class="cu-sidebar-footer">Footer content</div>
</aside>
```

**Page Header**
Bordered variant: add `cu-page-header-bordered` for a bottom border (opt-in).
Centered variant: add `cu-page-header-centered` for center-aligned layout (opt-in, ideal for marketing/landing pages).
```html
<div class="cu-page-header">
  <div class="cu-page-header-content">
    <h1 class="cu-page-header-title">Page Title</h1>
    <p class="cu-page-header-description">Description</p>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-page-header-actions">
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-default">Action</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Filter Bar**
```html
<div class="cu-filter-bar">
  <div class="cu-filter-bar-inner">
    <div class="cu-filter-bar-search">
      <div class="cu-search-input-wrapper">
        <input type="search" class="cu-search-input" placeholder="Search...">
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="cu-filter-bar-filters">
      <!-- filter dropdowns, buttons -->
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Resizable Panels** ⚡ Interactive — draggable split pane layout
Classes: `cu-resizable` (container, flex row), `cu-resizable-vertical` (vertical split, flex-col), `cu-resizable-panel` (flex-grow panel, proportional sizing), `cu-resizable-handle` (drag handle, 6px wide/tall, col-resize/row-resize cursor, grip indicator via `::after`)
Handle states: `data-cu-resizing` attribute applied during drag (stronger highlight).
Panel constraints: `data-cu-min-size` / `data-cu-max-size` (percentage).
Data attributes: `data-cu-resizable`, `data-cu-resizable-panel`, `data-cu-resizable-handle`
```html
<div class="cu-resizable" data-cu-resizable>
  <div class="cu-resizable-panel" data-cu-resizable-panel style="flex-grow: 50">
    Left panel
  </div>
  <div class="cu-resizable-handle" data-cu-resizable-handle role="separator" tabindex="0"></div>
  <div class="cu-resizable-panel" data-cu-resizable-panel style="flex-grow: 50">
    Right panel
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Vertical split -->
<div class="cu-resizable cu-resizable-vertical" data-cu-resizable>
  <div class="cu-resizable-panel" data-cu-resizable-panel style="flex-grow: 70">Top</div>
  <div class="cu-resizable-handle" data-cu-resizable-handle role="separator" tabindex="0"></div>
  <div class="cu-resizable-panel" data-cu-resizable-panel style="flex-grow: 30">Bottom</div>
</div>
```

**Scroll Area** — custom scrollbar styling
```html
<div class="cu-scroll-area" style="height: 200px">
  <!-- scrollable content -->
</div>
<!-- Horizontal: add cu-scroll-area-horizontal -->
```
