### AI

**Chat Bubble** — `cu-chat-bubble`, variants: `cu-chat-bubble-user` (right-aligned, primary bg), `cu-chat-bubble-assistant` (left-aligned, muted bg). Parts: `cu-chat-bubble-avatar`, `cu-chat-bubble-content`, `cu-chat-bubble-name`, `cu-chat-bubble-message`, `cu-chat-bubble-timestamp`, `cu-chat-bubble-actions`, `cu-chat-bubble-action`. Modifier: `cu-chat-bubble-message-prose` for markdown content.
```html
<div class="cu-chat-bubble cu-chat-bubble-assistant">
  <div class="cu-chat-bubble-avatar">
    <img src="avatar.png" alt="AI" />
  </div>
  <div class="cu-chat-bubble-content">
    <span class="cu-chat-bubble-name">Assistant</span>
    <div class="cu-chat-bubble-message">Hello! How can I help you?</div>
    <div class="cu-chat-bubble-actions">
      <button class="cu-chat-bubble-action" aria-label="Copy"><!-- icon --></button>
    </div>
    <span class="cu-chat-bubble-timestamp">2:30 PM</span>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="cu-chat-bubble cu-chat-bubble-user">
  <div class="cu-chat-bubble-content">
    <div class="cu-chat-bubble-message">Can you help me with CSS?</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Chat Input** — `cu-chat-input`, `cu-chat-input-field` (auto-growing textarea), `cu-chat-input-actions`, `cu-chat-input-send` (primary button), `cu-chat-input-attach` (ghost button).
```html
<div class="cu-chat-input">
  <textarea class="cu-chat-input-field" placeholder="Type a message..." rows="1"></textarea>
  <div class="cu-chat-input-actions">
    <button class="cu-chat-input-send" aria-label="Send"><!-- icon --></button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Chat Typing** — `cu-chat-typing`, `cu-chat-typing-dot`. Animated bouncing dots for AI thinking indicator. Combine with `cu-chat-bubble` structure for contextual display.
```html
<div class="cu-chat-typing">
  <span class="cu-chat-typing-dot"></span>
  <span class="cu-chat-typing-dot"></span>
  <span class="cu-chat-typing-dot"></span>
</div>
```

## Interactive Components — Complete data-* Attribute Reference

| Component | Container | Trigger | Content | Close/Action | Other |
|-----------|-----------|---------|---------|-------------|-------|
| Tabs | `data-cu-tabs` | `data-cu-tabs-trigger="value"` | `data-cu-tabs-content="value"` | `data-cu-tabs-close` | `data-cu-tabs-scrollable` |
| Dropdown | `data-cu-dropdown` | `data-cu-dropdown-trigger` | `data-cu-dropdown-content` | — | — |
| Carousel | `data-cu-carousel` | `data-cu-carousel-prev` / `data-cu-carousel-next` / `data-cu-carousel-dot` | `data-cu-carousel-viewport` | — | `data-cu-carousel-slide` (each slide) |
| Color Picker | `data-cu-color-picker` | — | — | — | `data-cu-color-picker-value`, `data-cu-color-picker-saturation`, `data-cu-color-picker-saturation-pointer`, `data-cu-color-picker-hue`, `data-cu-color-picker-hue-pointer`, `data-cu-color-picker-preview`, `data-cu-color-picker-input`, `data-cu-color-picker-hidden`, `data-cu-color-picker-swatch` |
| Combobox | `data-cu-combobox` | `data-cu-combobox-trigger` | `data-cu-combobox-content` | — | `data-cu-combobox-input`, `data-cu-combobox-item`, `data-cu-combobox-value`, `data-cu-combobox-list`, `data-cu-combobox-empty`, `data-cu-combobox-debounce` |
| Command Palette | `data-cu-command` (on `<dialog id="...">`) | `data-cu-command-trigger="id"` (or Ctrl / Cmd + K) | `data-cu-command-list` | — | `data-cu-command-input`, `data-cu-command-group`, `data-cu-command-item`, `data-cu-command-value`, `data-cu-command-separator`, `data-cu-command-empty`, `data-cu-command-active` (state, on active item) |
| Context Menu | `data-cu-context-menu` | — | `data-cu-context-menu-content` | — | — |
| Date Picker | `data-cu-date-picker` | `data-cu-date-picker-trigger` | `data-cu-date-picker-content` | — | `data-cu-date-picker-value`, `data-cu-date-picker-input` (hidden, fires `change`), plus the Calendar attributes below on the inner `.cu-calendar` |
| Calendar | `data-cu-calendar` | `data-cu-calendar-prev` / `data-cu-calendar-next` | `data-cu-calendar-grid` (rendered by JS) | — | `data-cu-calendar-title`, `data-cu-calendar-min`, `data-cu-calendar-max`, `data-cu-calendar-locale` |
| Checkbox Group | `data-cu-checkbox-group` | `data-cu-checkbox-group-selectall` | — | — | `data-cu-checkbox-group-item` |
| Segmented Control | `data-cu-segmented` | `.cu-segmented-item` buttons, or `.cu-segmented-input` radios + `<label for>` | — | — | — |
| Toggle Group | `data-cu-toggle-group` | `.cu-toggle-group-item` buttons | — | — | `data-cu-toggle-group-multiple` |
| Rating | `data-cu-rating` | `data-cu-rating-star="N"` (on `<button type="button">`) | — | — | `data-cu-rating-value`, `data-cu-rating-star-text` |
| Tag Input | `data-cu-tag-input` | — | — | `.cu-tag-input-tag-remove` | `data-cu-tag-input-field`, `data-cu-tag-max`, `data-cu-tag-value` |
| Sortable List | `data-cu-sortable-list` | — | — | — | `data-cu-sortable-item` (+ `draggable="true"`), `data-cu-sortable-handle` |
| Kanban | `data-cu-kanban` | — | `data-cu-kanban-column-body` | — | `data-cu-kanban-column`, `data-cu-kanban-card` (+ `draggable="true"`) |
| Countdown | `data-cu-countdown` | — | — | — | `data-cu-countdown-target`, `data-cu-countdown-days` / `-hours` / `-minutes` / `-seconds` (on the value elements) |
| Image Compare | `data-cu-image-compare` | — | — | — | — |
| Speed Dial | `data-cu-speed-dial` | `data-cu-speed-dial-trigger` | `data-cu-speed-dial-actions` | — | `data-cu-open` (state) |
| Back to Top | `data-cu-back-to-top` (on the button) | — | — | — | `data-cu-back-to-top-threshold`, `data-cu-visible` (state) |
| Tour | `data-cu-tour` | `cu:tour:start` event | — | — | `data-cu-tour-steps`, `data-cu-tour-auto` |
